title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Response Commitments and Credit Ceilings
content:
## The commitment each program carries

Each of the Demand Service Rate Programs carries a guaranteed on-site response for a routine demand
call, for a priority call, for an emergency call and for a call at a critical facility, each stated in
elapsed hours. The queue position is the program's position in the dispatch queue when several calls
compete for the same technician, 1 being the highest. The after-hours column states whether the program
accepts dispatch outside regular hours at all.

| Program | Routine (hours) | Priority (hours) | Emergency (hours) | Critical facility (hours) | Queue position | After-hours dispatch accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 72 | 48 | 24 | 24 | 5 | No |
| Priority Response Program | 48 | 24 | 12 | 12 | 4 | Yes |
| Block Hour Service Program | 48 | 24 | 8 | 8 | 3 | Yes |
| Emergency Response Program | 24 | 8 | 4 | 4 | 2 | Yes |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 12 | 4 | 2 | 2 | 1 | Yes |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 8 | 4 | 2 | 2 | 1 | Yes |

## Credit for a missed response

The credit rate is the credit of the call's labor charge where the response guarantee is missed, stated
in percent, and the ceiling is the most that is paid for one missed response, in US dollars.

| Program | Credit rate (percent of the labor charge) | Ceiling for one missed response (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 0 | 0 |
| Priority Response Program | 25 | 500 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 25 | 750 |
| Emergency Response Program | 50 | 1500 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 100 | 3500 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 100 | 5000 |

### Points of judgement

- The Time & Material Account carries a credit rate of 0 and a ceiling of 0: that program carries no
  response guarantee to credit.
- The routine, priority, emergency and critical figures are separate commitments; the figure that
  governs a call is the one for the classification that call was given.
- At the Critical Facility Response Program and the Dedicated Technician Program the critical and
  emergency commitments are the same 2 hours, and the queue position is 1 at both.
